source_conclusions: The provider-arrival had_audio latch is removed. Owner boot and turn must match before OR-ing reached_speaker.
reached_speaker is sounded or playback; service_speaker_control sets both only for positive accepted frames after sequence/origin validation.
Top-of-loop and both candidate-drain arms latch after speaker receipts, before subsequent lapse/interruption handling can drop Reply.
Completion uses heard_whole first, otherwise never reached plus never latched gives Unsaid; normal walk poll uses same accepted-playback rule.
New invitation binding resets the audio latch; other owner does not latch. Unsaid refunds the bound invitation try within its existing bounded retry policy.
limits: New cases manually construct latch/decision states; no full coordinator replay of a bound invitation or physical/acoustic measurement.
Original a4 HOLD remains in its historical proof. Author 13/0 and759/0 are not independent current host credit.
